description: This file defines a Java class KernelStackFrameSnapshot that represents a kernel stack frame within a bug report stack trace. It extends StackFrameSnapshot and adds specific fields related to kernel frames, such as 'syscall', 'offset0', and 'offset1'. It also provides copy construction and cloning methods.

classes.name: KernelStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a kernel stack frame, extending StackFrameSnapshot with kernel-specific details.
